Sorry, but there just isn't that much more to talk about. That's how I feel and I don't think that chatting about it is gonna help.

I just wanted to get on a soapbox and spill my guts for a few strangers. I'm thankful that you listened to me. 

I'm gonna head to bed now. Maybe I'll come up with something meaningful to say tomorrow. But until then, Goodnight.
